title: The 5 things I'm glad I knew as a psychology undergraduate

sentences.en: Psychologists, what if you could earn money beyond trading your time for money?
sentences.zh: 心理学家们，如果你们除了用时间换取金钱之外还能赚钱，会怎么样？

sentences.en: I'm Dr. Marianne Trent, clinical psychologist, and I've been developing passive and recurring income streams since 2019.
sentences.zh: 我是玛丽安·特伦特博士，临床心理学家，自2019年以来，我一直在开发被动收入和循环收入流。

sentences.en: I have some exciting news.
sentences.zh: 我有一些令人兴奋的消息。

sentences.en: Sophie Foote's One-to-Many program is now open for enrollment.
sentences.zh: 苏菲·富特的“一对多”项目现在开放报名了。

sentences.en: It's designed to help you turn your expertise into scalable offers like courses, memberships, and digital products.
sentences.zh: 它旨在帮助你将专业知识转化为可扩展的产品，比如课程、会员资格和数字产品。

sentences.en: I completed the program myself in 2022 and have since supported two cohorts of psychologists through their journeys too.
sentences.zh: 我在2022年自己完成了这个项目，此后也一直支持两期心理学家学员走过他们的历程。

sentences.en: And if you join through my affiliate link, you'll receive Sophie's bonuses plus my own exclusive support package at no extra coSt.
sentences.zh: 如果你通过我的推广链接加入，你将获得苏菲的奖品以及我专属的支持套餐，无需支付额外费用。

sentences.en: That includes six months of WhatsApp support, four group masterminds, masterclasses, personalized guidance, a Fortnum and Mason treat, and a time-limited one-to-one coaching bonus.
sentences.zh: 这包括六个月的WhatsApp支持、四场小组智囊会、大师班、个性化指导、一份福特南 & 梅森的礼品，以及限时的“一对一”教练指导福利。

sentences.en: Enrollment closes on Monday the 16th of November at 10pm.
sentences.zh: 报名将于11月16日星期一晚上10点截止。

sentences.en: Find out more via my bonus page linked in the description.
sentences.zh: 通过简介中链接的我的福利页面了解更多信息。

sentences.en: And remember, you must purchase through my link to receive my bonuses.
sentences.zh: 请记住，你必须通过我的链接购买才能获得我的福利。

sentences.en: I'm here if you have any questions.
sentences.zh: 如果你有任何问题，我随时都在。

sentences.en: Coming up in today's episode, I am guiding you through the five things that I am super glad that I did know as a psychology undergraduate.
sentences.zh: 在今天的节目中，我将带领大家了解作为一名心理学本科生，我超级庆幸自己当时就知道的五件事。

sentences.en: Hope you'll find this useful whatever stage of career you are at.
sentences.zh: 希望无论你处于职业生涯的哪个阶段，都会觉得这很有用。

sentences.en: And it is coming up right now.
sentences.zh: 节目马上开始。

sentences.en: So stay tuned.
sentences.zh: 所以请拭目以待。

sentences.en: Welcome along to the Aspiring Psychologist podcaSt.
sentences.zh: 欢迎收听《有志心理学家》播客。

sentences.en: I am Dr. Marianne Trent and I'm a qualified clinical psychologiSt.
sentences.zh: 我是玛丽安·特伦特博士，是一名合格的临床心理学家。

sentences.en: We recently did an episode about the five things that I wish I'd known as an undergraduate psychology student.
sentences.zh: 我们最近做了一期节目，关于我希望在本科心理学学习期间就知道的五件事。

sentences.en: And that got me thinking about the five things that I'm glad I did know as a psychology undergraduate student.
sentences.zh: 这让我开始思考作为一名心理学本科生，我庆幸自己确实知道的五件事。

sentences.en: So this might well be the second half of that very recent episode, which you can watch by checking out my YouTube.
sentences.zh: 所以这很可能是那期最新节目的下半部分，你可以通过查看我的YouTube来观看。

sentences.en: I'm going to the Aspiring Psychologist podcast playlist or via scanning the QR code on screen now.
sentences.zh: 前往《有志心理学家》播客播放列表，或者通过扫描屏幕上的二维码。

sentences.en: I'm heading to the Aspiring Psychologist podcast where you can listen to that yourself.
sentences.zh: 前往《有志心理学家》播客，你可以在那里亲自收听。

sentences.en: Or you can come over to Apple podcasts or Spotify to listen to it directly from there or basically on my website.
sentences.zh: 或者你可以来Apple Podcasts或Spotify直接收听，或者基本上在我的网站上收听。

sentences.en: There's not many places that you can't stumble into either the podcast or the YouTube version of it.
sentences.zh: 几乎没有哪个地方是你找不到这个播客或其YouTube版本的。

sentences.en: If you are watching on YouTube, please do subscribe, like, comment, tell your friends.
sentences.zh: 如果你正在YouTube上观看，请务必订阅、点赞、评论并告诉你的朋友。

sentences.en: So let's plough on with first of the five things that I'm glad I knew as a psychology undergraduate.
sentences.zh: 让我们继续推进我庆幸自己作为心理学本科生就知道的五件事中的第一件。

sentences.en: It might sound a little bit silly, but university is not just about studying.
sentences.zh: 听起来可能有点傻，但大学不仅仅是学习。

sentences.en: You know, I learned so much from the people I met.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，我从遇到的人身上学到了很多。

sentences.en: I learned about having fun.
sentences.zh: 我学会了如何享受乐趣。

sentences.en: I learned about, you know, managing my own household, cooking, cleaning, trying my best to live with people that weren't blood related to me and not having them want to kill me,
sentences.zh: 我学会了，你知道的，管理自己的家务、做饭、打扫卫生，尽最大努力和没有血缘关系的人一起生活，别让他们想谋杀我，

sentences.en: you know, and vice versa.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，反之亦然。

sentences.en: You know, I learned a lot.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，我学到了很多。

sentences.en: And, you know, about cooperation, about, you know, bill paying and, you know, sharing the bathroom with other adolescent females was interesting.
sentences.zh: 关于合作，关于付账单，还有和别的青春期女性共用浴室真的很有趣。

sentences.en: Having to wait your turn, book in for, you know, the bathroom, whereas that's not something I'd experienced, you know, where I grew up with just me and my brother.
sentences.zh: 必须排队等候，预订浴室的使用时间，然而这并不是我在家里和哥哥一起长大时经历过的。

sentences.en: So that was unique and special and important.
sentences.zh: 所以这很独特、很特别也很重要。

sentences.en: But also, you know, I guess I was busy cultivating friendships.
sentences.zh: 但同时，我想我也一直在建立友谊。

sentences.en: So maybe I always knew that the people that I would spend time with in 1999 to 2002 would go on to become my lifelong friends.
sentences.zh: 所以也许我一直都知道，我在1999年到2002年期间共度时光的人将会成为我一生的朋友。

sentences.en: Not just friends for a season, not just friends for undergrad, but that, you know, in 2023 and beyond, we'd still be setting aside time in our diaries.
sentences.zh: 不仅仅是一季的朋友，不仅仅是本科的朋友，而是，你知道的，在2023年及以后，我们依然会在日程表中留出时间。

sentences.en: To make new memories and to reflect upon the old ones and that our children would grow up knowing these people and, you know, spending time with them.
sentences.zh: 去创造新的回忆，去反思旧的回忆，我们的孩子长大后也会认识这些人，并和他们共度时光。

sentences.en: These are not necessarily just people for right now.
sentences.zh: 这些不一定只是当下的人。

sentences.en: These might well be, you know, certainly one of the girls that I met there was my bridesmaid.
sentences.zh: 这些很可能是，当然，我在那里遇到的一位女孩后来成了我的伴娘。

sentences.en: You know, really important people that we meet along the way in our psychology undergrad, although none of them were doing psychology undergrad.
sentences.zh: 我们在心理学本科路上遇到的人真的很重要，尽管他们当时都不是学心理学本科的。

sentences.en: But the three friends that I was very close to when I was doing my psychology undergrad, we are still very close friends.
sentences.zh: 但我在读心理学本科时非常亲密的三个朋友，我们现在依然是非常要好的朋友。

sentences.en: And we've been through some real highs and lows together.
sentences.zh: 我们一起经历了一些真正的高潮和低谷。

sentences.en: So, yeah, the people that I was hanging out with all the time are still in my life.
sentences.zh: 所以，是的，我一直混在一起的人现在依然在我的生活中。

sentences.en: And I'm really pleased and really proud to say that that is the case.
sentences.zh: 我非常高兴也非常自豪地说，事实确实如此。

sentences.en: You know, you're learning a lot.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，你学到了很多。

sentences.en: It's not just about going to university, going to the lectures, going to the seminars, getting your essays done.
sentences.zh: 不仅仅是去大学、去上讲座、去上研讨班、写论文。

sentences.en: Of course, it's about that.
sentences.zh: 当然，这些是有的。

sentences.en: But there is so much more.
sentences.zh: 但还有更多更多。

sentences.en: And I think I did know that at uni.
sentences.zh: 我想我在大学时确实知道这一点。

sentences.en: Number two that I'm glad about is that, you know, I did have quite a lot of time off in my psychology undergrad.
sentences.zh: 我感到庆幸的第二点是，我在心理学本科期间确实有很多空闲时间。

sentences.en: And so I knew that I had some time to be able to work whilst studying.
sentences.zh: 所以我知道我有一些时间可以在学习的同时兼职工作。

sentences.en: And so work is what I did.
sentences.zh: 所以我确实去工作了。

sentences.en: On my second year onwards, I worked with disabled students, helping them to be able to access a level playing field, to be able to do their lectures.
sentences.zh: 从我的大二开始，我为残疾学生工作，帮助他们获得公平的竞争环境来听讲座。

sentences.en: I'd help them take notes, or I'd help scribe in interviews, or I'd help scribe in exaMs.
sentences.zh: 我帮他们做笔记，或者在面试中帮他们代笔，或者在考试中帮他们代笔。

sentences.en: How they read my own writing at that point, I don't know, but they did manage to do it.
sentences.zh: 当时他们是怎么看懂我的字迹的，我不知道，但他们确实设法看懂了。

sentences.en: And that might be transient disabilities.
sentences.zh: 这可能是暂时的残疾。

sentences.en: It might be someone broke an arm or a leg.
sentences.zh: 可能是某人胳膊或腿骨折了。

sentences.en: I'd help them get lectures and make sure they were okay and support them.
sentences.zh: 我会帮他们去听讲座，确保他们没事并支持他们。

sentences.en: Or it might be more chronic disabilities, you know, for a variety of reasons that meant that they needed some extra support.
sentences.zh: 或者可能是更长期的残疾，你知道的，由于各种原因，这意味着他们需要一些额外的支持。

sentences.en: So I learned a load of that, and I really enjoyed it.
sentences.zh: 所以我学到了很多，而且我真的很喜欢。

sentences.en: And it also put extra money in my pocket, which was great.
sentences.zh: 这也让我的口袋里多了一些零花钱，这太棒了。

sentences.en: Let's take a brief break here, and I'll be back along with points 3, points 4, and points 5.
sentences.zh: 我们在这里休息一下，稍后我将回来讲解第3点、第4点和第5点。

sentences.en: Thank you for listening.
sentences.zh: 谢谢收听。

sentences.en: In the first half, we were looking at the first two things that I'm really glad that I did know when I was a psychology undergraduate student.
sentences.zh: 在前半部分中，我们探讨了我作为一名心理学本科生时，真正庆幸自己知道的前两件事。

sentences.en: Let's crack on with point number 3.
sentences.zh: 让我们接着讲第3点。

sentences.en: I'm sort of glad that I gave myself permission to do a degree that interested me without necessarily knowing where that was going to take me.
sentences.zh: 我有点庆幸自己允许自己去读一个感兴趣的学位，而不必非得知道这会把我带向何方。

sentences.en: You know, just to make it quite an exploratory degree, to allow, you know, the things that I enjoyed about what I was learning to percolate through me.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，就把它当成一个充满探索性的学位，让我在学习中享受的事物在我的内心沉淀。

sentences.en: And then ultimately, to come to me in the final weeks of term of my final year, that I thought, I want to be a clinical psychologiSt.
sentences.zh: 然后最终，在我的最后学年的最后几周，这个想法找到了我：我想成为一名临床心理学家。

sentences.en: So if I realised that earlier, I might well have been able to do other things.
sentences.zh: 所以如果我早点意识到这一点，我可能就能做别的事情了。

sentences.en: But I think it's okay that I got there when I did, and I kind of gave myself that holistic experience of being an undergrad student.
sentences.zh: 但我认为我在那个时候达到了这个目标是没问题的，我给自己带来了作为本科生的这种整体体验。

sentences.en: I think if I realised about clinical psychology before, I might have felt much more pressure, and it might have felt much more competitive, and I might have burned myself out.
sentences.zh: 我想如果我以前意识到临床心理学，我可能会感到更大的压力，感觉竞争会更激烈，我也可能会让自己精疲力竭。

sentences.en: So I'm kind of pleased that I just, you know, took it all as it came, and, you know, got my assignments done, had fun with my friends,
sentences.zh: 所以我有点高兴我只是顺其自然，完成了作业，和朋友们玩得开心，

sentences.en: and then, you know, fell into, stumbled across clinical psychology when the time was right for me.
sentences.zh: 然后，在对的时机，偶然接触并爱上了临床心理学。

sentences.en: Point number four, I'm actually really glad that I knew that actually, for me, using my university vacations over the summer was a great idea to be able to work,
sentences.zh: 第四点，我其实真的很高兴自己知道，对我来说，利用夏天的大学假期去工作是一个极好的主意，

sentences.en: to be able to gain some extra money.
sentences.zh: 能够赚取一些额外的钱。

sentences.en: I did quite like shopping in Topshop at most times.
sentences.zh: 我大多数时候确实挺喜欢在Topshop买东西的。

sentences.en: And so when I was at university, it was nice to be able to have some money to afford noodles, food, you know, the odd pint of beer.
sentences.zh: 所以在大学时，能有一些钱买得起速食面、食物和偶尔的一品脱啤酒，感觉真好。

sentences.en: I'm not really a very good beer drinker, but, you know, I used to drink that, and, you know, vodka, lemonade, and lime.
sentences.zh: 我其实不是一个很会喝啤酒的人，但是，你知道的，我以前喝那个，还有伏金柠檬加青柠。

sentences.en: I can't think where else I used to drink.
sentences.zh: 我想不起来我还喝过什么别的了。

sentences.en: Martini?
sentences.zh: 马提尼？

sentences.en: No, not martini.
sentences.zh: 不，不是马提尼。

sentences.en: I can't think where else I used to drink.
sentences.zh: 我想不起来我还喝过什么别的了。

sentences.en: I have to ask my university friends on the next season what I used to drink.
sentences.zh: 我得在下一个季节问问我的大学朋友我以前都喝什么。

sentences.en: Yeah, but I used to use my work, my summer vacation, to work either as a home carer or to work in boots chemists,
sentences.zh: 是的，但我过去常常利用我的暑假，要么做家庭护理员，要么在博姿药妆店工作，

sentences.en: to earn some money to be able to pay off my overdraft, be able to pay a chunk of my tuition fees as well.
sentences.zh: 赚点钱来还清透支，也能付清一部分学费。

sentences.en: So, yeah, I knew that, and I'm glad, because it gave me structure.
sentences.zh: 所以，是的，我知道这一点，我很高兴，因为它给了我结构。

sentences.en: It meant that I didn't just use the whole of my summer vacations to just sleep.
sentences.zh: 这意味着我没有把整个暑假都用来睡觉。

sentences.en: You know, and I wouldn't have been able to go out and socialise at all over my university holidays if I hadn't worked,
sentences.zh: 你知道的，如果我没有工作，我在大学假期里根本无法出去社交，

sentences.en: because, of course, I needed money to be able to do those things as well.
sentences.zh: 因为我当然也需要钱来做那些事情。

sentences.en: So, for me, you know, working was a really sensible thing to do.
sentences.zh: 所以，对我来说，工作是一件非常明智的事情。

sentences.en: And working in boots to chemists meant that I learned a great deal about working with others,
sentences.zh: 在博姿药妆店工作意味着我学到了很多关于如何与他人合作的知识，

sentences.en: and, you know, customer service and, you know, teamwork, you know, helping make things harmonious.
sentences.zh: 还有客户服务、团队合作以及如何让事情保持和谐。

sentences.en: And that leads us nicely into point five, really, which is what I've called teamwork makes the dream work.
sentences.zh: 这很好地引出了我们的第五点，我称之为“团队合作成就梦想”。

sentences.en: And that's about that holistic experience of learning from others, you know, watching them grow, watching ourselves grow, you know, knowing that we're all in this together,
sentences.zh: 这就是关于向他人学习的整体体验，看着他们成长，看着我们自己成长，知道我们都在一条船上，

sentences.en: and that there's something very special about a cohort.
sentences.zh: 一个团队有着非常特殊意义。

sentences.en: And, you know, watching that development across a cohort is really, really special, you know.
sentences.zh: 而且，你知道的，看着整个团队的发展真的非常非常特别。

sentences.en: And, you know, we used to draw upon each other's strengths and skills to help us to understand things better.
sentences.zh: 而且，你知道的，我们过去常常利用彼此的优势和技能来帮助我们更好地理解事物。

sentences.en: But also, you know, when it came to lectures, across the four of us, one of us would definitely be there,
sentences.zh: 但是，你知道的，当要上讲座时，我们四个人之中肯定会有一个人在场，

sentences.en: and so we would share lecture notes for any lectures that we hadn't been to.
sentences.zh: 所以我们会分享我们没有去上的任何讲座的笔记。

sentences.en: And I'm sure in modern-day universities, you know, attending is a bit easier if you're able to do it online,
sentences.zh: 我确信在现代大学里，如果你能在线上课，出勤会更容易一些，

sentences.en: and probably lecture notes are all available as a download at the click of a button.
sentences.zh: 而且讲座笔记可能只需要点击一下按钮就可以全部下载下来。

sentences.en: But in my day when I was studying, you had to go take actual pen and paper.
sentences.zh: 但在我学习的年代，你必须去拿真正的纸和笔。

sentences.en: There was probably only one person that had a laptop in those days, and they were seen as very fancy.
sentences.zh: 那个年代可能只有一个人有笔记本电脑，他们被视为非常时髦。

sentences.en: They're one that you could take out with you and type in a lecture.
sentences.zh: 那是你可以随身携带并在讲座中打字的电脑。

sentences.en: So, yeah, teamwork most definitely made the dream work.
sentences.zh: 所以，是的，团队合作绝对成就了梦想。

sentences.en: And, yeah, just really fun, special memories of all the cohorts that I trained with.
sentences.zh: 而且，对于和我一起接受培训的所有团队，真的有非常有趣、特别的回忆。

sentences.en: So, has this evoked any memories, thoughts, reflections for you?
sentences.zh: 那么，这是否为你唤起了任何回忆、想法或反思？

sentences.en: Has it enabled you to reflect on where you're at right now in your career as an aspiring psychologist?
sentences.zh: 它是否让你反思了自己作为一名有志心理学家目前在职业生涯中所处的位置？

sentences.en: I would love to know what you think.
sentences.zh: 我很想知道你的想法。

sentences.en: Come and let me know on the Aspiring Psychologist Community, a three-day group of Dr. C.A.M.P.
sentences.zh: 来“有志心理学家社区”告诉我吧，这是一个为期三天的C.A.M.P.博士小组。

sentences.en: Please do also consider joining the Aspiring Psychologist Membership, where we really help supercharge your abilities, your skills, your potential,
sentences.zh: 也请考虑加入“有志心理学家会员计划”，在这里我们真正帮助你全面提升你的能力、技能和潜力，

sentences.en: across a wide range of things, from relation to research to personal reflections, and across a wide range of different therapeutic orientations.
sentences.zh: 涵盖广泛的内容，从关系到研究再到个人反思，以及各种不同的治疗方向。

sentences.en: It gets great reviews.
sentences.zh: 它获得了极好的评价。

sentences.en: We'd love to see you in there and to really continue that theme of teamwork and making the dream work.
sentences.zh: 我们很期待在那里见到你，并真正延续团队合作成就梦想的主题。

sentences.en: That really is what you think is in the membership.
sentences.zh: 这真的是你对会员计划的看法。

sentences.en: I will look forward to catching up with you for the next episode of the Aspiring Psychologist podcast, which will be along for you on 6 a.m.
sentences.zh: 我期待着在下一期《有志心理学家》播客中与你见面，该节目将于周一上午6点为你播出。

sentences.en: on Monday.
sentences.zh: 在星期一。

sentences.en: Thank you so much for being part of my world.
sentences.zh: 非常感谢你成为我世界的一部分。

sentences.en: I will look forward to catching up with you very soon.
sentences.zh: 我期待着很快与你交流。

sentences.en: Take care.
sentences.zh: 保重。

sentences.en: Psychologists, what if you could earn money beyond trading your time for money?
sentences.zh: 心理学家们，如果你们除了用时间换取金钱之外还能赚钱，会怎么样？

sentences.en: I'm Dr. Marianne Trent, clinical psychologist, and I've been developing passive and recurring income streams since 2019.
sentences.zh: 我是玛丽安·特伦特博士，临床心理学家，自2019年以来，我一直在开发被动收入和循环收入流。

sentences.en: I have some exciting news.
sentences.zh: 我有一些令人兴奋的消息。

sentences.en: Sophie Foote's one-to-many program is now open for enrolment.
sentences.zh: 苏菲·富特的“一对多”项目现在开放报名了。

sentences.en: It's designed to help you turn your expertise into scalable offers like courses, memberships, and digital products.
sentences.zh: 它旨在帮助你将专业知识转化为可扩展的产品，比如课程、会员资格和数字产品。

sentences.en: I completed the program myself in 2022, and have since supported two cohorts of psychologists through their journeys too.
sentences.zh: 我在2022年自己完成了这个项目，此后也一直支持两期心理学家学员走过他们的历程。

sentences.en: And if you join through my affiliate link, you'll receive Sophie's bonuses plus my own exclusive support package at no extra coSt.
sentences.zh: 如果你通过我的推广链接加入，你将获得苏菲的奖品以及我专属的支持套餐，无需支付额外费用。

sentences.en: That includes six months of WhatsApp support, four group masterminds, masterclasses, personalized guidance, a Fortnum and Mason treat, and a time-limited one-to-one coaching bonus.
sentences.zh: 这包括六个月的WhatsApp support、四场小组智囊会、大师班、个性化指导、一份福特南 & 梅森的礼品，以及限时的“一对一”教练指导福利。

sentences.en: Enrolment closes on Monday the 16th of November at 10 p.m.
sentences.zh: 报名将于11月16日星期一晚上10点截止。

sentences.en: Find out more via my bonus page linked in the description.
sentences.zh: 通过简介中链接的我的福利页面了解更多信息。

sentences.en: And remember, you must purchase through my link to receive my bonuses.
sentences.zh: 请记住，你必须通过我的链接购买才能获得我的福利。

sentences.en: I'm here if you have any questions.
sentences.zh: 如果你有任何问题，我随时都在。
